Mali.title: West Africa: Sahel - Violent fighting between Jnim and ISIS jihadists on the Mali-Burkina border
Mali.summary: Since August, there has been significant fighting between the jihadists of Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda, and their rivals the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS). These fights are taking place on the border between Mali and Burkina Faso, also not far from the Nigerian border. The last clashes took place at the end of last week, mainly on Friday, October 9 in Gonadaouri, in the Burkinabe province of Oudalan .

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike two terrorist positions near Dioura and Tongolo Coura
Mali.summary: Through the exploitation of precise intelligence, the Malian Armed Forces targeted two sites attributed to terrorist groups on 14 and 15 October 2026. These actions are part of the dynamics of surveillance, control and security operations in the national territory . Bamada.net-The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) continue their operations in different theaters of intervention in order to strengthen the security of the national territory and reduce the nuisance capacities of armed terrorist groups .

Burkina Faso.title: West Africa: A war within a war - The clash between JNIM and the Islamic State in the Sahel
Burkina Faso.summary: Ouagadougou — A war within a war. It is the one that takes place in the sands of the Sahara, in the area of the triple border between Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso, where the two main jihadist groups active in the region clash: Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM, Group in support of Islam and Muslims) and the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS). The former is affiliated with Al-Qaeda, while the latter is linked to the Islamic State.
